action.objective: Verify e1d1 as the reserved candidate, checking king safety against Black queen and rook threats on the c-file.
action.rationale: Broad depth-2 search suggested e1d1 (score 65, exact). This move steps the rook off the e-file, connecting rooks and evading potential c-file pressure. However, Black's queen on c3 and rook on c2 already control the c-file, and d1 may still be exposed to c3-c1+ or c2-d2 ideas. Single-candidate verification at full depth is required to confirm safety and produce a commit-ready evaluation.
